values: 一名敏锐灵巧的游侠，能打断敌人的终极技能，并且能在战斗中持续成长。
An agile Rogue who can interrupt enemy's Ultimate and continue to grow throughout the battle.
明白了，我会让他们安静下来的。
I need to... rest for a while.
这样就能得到夸奖了吧？
I'll be praised for this, right?
I had a feeling you would be here.
Who's there? Oh, just a leaf.
我会飞得越来越高、越来越远。
I'm going to fly higher and farther.
这个……有一种熟悉的感觉，我很喜欢。
This... feels familiar. I like it.
这也是，给好孩子的奖励吗？
Is this my reward for being good?
像一场突如其来的阵雨。
黑夜之中，她的视野仍毫不受阻。
Her vision remains clear even in the darkness.
Ah, I feel much more relaxed now...
This is my first time having this...
Colored lights, good food, and monsters...
The fireworks are so pretty... so warm.
阿尔法十一是五月在黑金商会实验计划中的代号。在此之前，黑金商会培养过十个实验品。
Codenamed Aves 11 in the Adamant Syndicate's experimental program, Lily May is the fastest-growing subject. Before her, the Adamant Syndicate had trained ten other test subjects.
据黑金商会的成员说，五月睡觉很浅，只要有一点声音就会醒来，因此总是放心让她守夜。
According to a Syndicate member, Lily May is a light sleeper. She wakes at the faintest sound, making her perfect for night watch duty.
“阿尔法十一是这批实验品里成长最快的。”——摘自黑金商会研究员的手记。
"Aves 11 is the fastest-growing among this batch of test subjects." —An excerpt from a Syndicate researcher's notes
据说，五月幼时不知降雨为何物，听见了密密麻麻的水滴从天而降的声音，还以为是营地遭到了袭击。
It's said that Lily May didn't know what rain was when she was young. When she first heard countless raindrops falling from the sky, she thought the camp was under attack.
一位薄暮巡游队员开心地表示，最近在丛林边缘发现了已经迁居的告雨一族成员，也许这证明腐化危机彻底解除。
A Dusk Patroller recently reported discovering relocated members of the Azure Seers at the forest's edge, possibly proving the corruption crisis has been resolved.
五月的毛发具有告雨一族的防水特性，能够在雨中自如地急速穿行。
Lily May's waterproof feathers allow her to move effortlessly in the rain, a trait of the Azure Seers.
据说，五月喜欢在高处观察地上的形势，她曾对黑金商会成员说过，这样更有利于瞄准。
Lily May likes to observe the ground from high places. She once told a Syndicate member that this vantage point is better for aiming.
黑金商会的战斗教官，曾因为五月精准的射术，误判其在近身战中的实力。
Her precise shooting skills once led a Syndicate instructor to underestimate her close combat abilities.
五月似乎并不知道死亡为何物，对于她来说，执行任务只是让那些人提前睡去，等到第二天太阳升起，他们便会醒来。
Lily May seems unaware of what death truly means. She believes that executing a mission puts people to sleep, and when the sun rises the next day, they wake up.
据黑金商会的文书记载，五月的耐痛性极强，所以战斗进步神速。她似乎不觉得疼痛和濒死感是值得恐惧的事。
Adamant Syndicate records note her high pain tolerance, which is why she progresses so quickly in combat. Lily May seemingly doesn't fear pain or neath-death experiences.
It's raining outside... So wet and humid...
嗯，蔬菜和草药你基本都认识，特殊的果实你也学过了……
Now, you've familiarized yourself with nearly all the vegetables, herbs, and special fruits...
This is my first time having this...
Colored lights, good food, and monsters...
The fireworks are so pretty... so warm.
